title: User operational knowledge is evidence
issue_presented: Is asking the user how an existing system is actually used a failure of agent autonomy?

known_facts.fact: User instruction: if repositories and records cannot establish actual use, asking the user is evidence gathering.

analysis: The user is a legitimate source of operational facts. Questions must be specific.
judgment_rule: The user is a legitimate source of operational facts.
If repositories and records cannot establish how an existing system is actually used, asking the user is part of evidence gathering. It is not a failure of agent autonomy.
The agent must ask a specific factual question, not hand the entire technical problem back to the user.
operational_effect: USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED entries must contain a specific question string.
